title: Email
description: SMTP connection and email templates for your company. Leave the SMTP host empty to use the global configuration.
ownerOnly: Only owners can manage email settings.
passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
useSsl: Use TLS (port 465: implicit TLS, other ports: STARTTLS)
templateHint: Empty fields use the default template in the sending language. Custom templates apply to both languages. Enter plain text without HTML; line breaks are preserved.
placeholders: Placeholders: {Rechnungsnummer} (document number), {Belegart} (document type), {Betrag} (gross amount in EUR), {Fälligkeitsdatum} (due date), {Kundenname} (customer), {Firmenname} (company). Unknown placeholders remain unchanged.
dunningPlaceholders: Also available: {Mahnstufe} (level name), {Mahngebühr} (fee). The due date refers to the invoice.
subject: Subject
testHint: Uses the saved configuration. Save changes first. Leave the recipient empty to use your own email address.
testError: Could not send the test email. Check the recipient and SMTP settings.
